name: VIA University College
about: VIA is a university college (professionshøjskole) in central and western Jutland, and it teaches eleven first degrees in English. Most of them are in Horsens: engineering, software and construction management, taught as applied degrees with a 20-week internship. Viborg has The Animation Workshop, whose three talent-based animation and illustration degrees admit on a portfolio and an admission test, plus a software degree specialising in XR. Herning has a two-year AP degree in design, technology and business.
ibNotes: No page read for this institution mentions DP Course Results. The canonical Opportunities apply the national rule (ev-ufsn-ib-course-results): Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 in all six subjects and three at HL, give access to AP and professional bachelor programmes.

deadlines.label: Application (IB and all international qualifications)
deadlines.notes: Through optagelse.dk, which opens on 1 February.

sources.title: VIA's list of English-taught bachelor's and AP degree programmes, and its statement that bachelor's degrees at university colleges are professional bachelor's degrees.

Every VIA English-taught programme needs English at Danish B level with a weighted average of at least 2.0, or an accepted test (IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 94 before 21 January 2026 or 4.5 after, Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency at 180). A test cannot replace English where it is a specific entry requirement.

Architectural Technology and Construction Management (Horsens): a 3.5-year, 210 ECTS bachelor with August and February starts, admitting IB holders with Mathematics at C level (passed with at least 2.0), and selecting in quota 2 on a motivational video, grades, work experience and stays abroad.
Construction Technology (Horsens) is a two-year, 120 ECTS Academy Profession (AP) degree with an August start, admitting IB holders with Mathematics at C level (passed with at least 2.0).

Design, Technology and Business (Herning) is a two-year, 120 ECTS AP degree taught in English, with an admissions assignment, Mathematics C, and English B (or English C with a valid English test), each passed with at least 2.0.

Climate and Supply Engineering (Horsens) is a 3.5-year Bachelor of Engineering starting in August. It needs Mathematics A, Physics B or Geoscience A, Chemistry C or Biotechnology A, and English B, each passed with at least 2.0.
Global Business Engineering (Horsens) is a 4.5-year Bachelor of Engineering starting in August. It needs Mathematics B and English A, each passed with at least 2.0.

Mechanical Engineering (Horsens) is a 3.5-year Bachelor of Engineering starting in August. It needs Mathematics A, English B, Physics B or Geoscience A, and Chemistry C or Biotechnology A, each passed with at least 2.0.
Software Technology Engineering (Horsens) is a 3.5-year Bachelor of Engineering starting in September. It needs Mathematics A, Physics B or Geoscience A, and English B, each passed with at least 2.0.

Software Technology Engineering, specialised in XR (Viborg), is a 3.5-year Bachelor of Engineering starting in August. It needs Mathematics A, Physics B or Geoscience A, and English B, each passed with at least 2.0.
Character Animation (Viborg) is a bachelor of 3 years 3 months, starting in August and admitting once a year. Admission is talent-based and every applicant takes an admissions test.
Computer Graphic Arts (Viborg) is a bachelor of 3 years 3 months starting in August. Admission is talent-based and every applicant takes an admissions test.

Graphic Storytelling (Viborg) is a bachelor of 3 years 9 months, starting in August and admitting only in odd-numbered years, so 2027 is an intake year. Admission is talent-based and every applicant takes an admissions test.

notes: Research notes kept for the record. The site renders the canonical records in data/institutions, data/programmes and data/opportunities, whose evidence is in data/evidence/dk-colleges.json.

Each VIA programme page says every specific subject must be passed with a minimum average of 2.0 on the Danish scale. Applicants with non-Danish qualifications are asked for a verification form, stamped by their school, that confirms the hours taught in each required subject over the last three years.

The English-proficiency rule is shared across VIA: English at Danish B level with a weighted average of at least 2.0, or an accepted test such as IELTS Academic 6.5. A test cannot replace English where a programme names it as a specific requirement.

Software Technology Engineering, Cybersecurity specialisation (Horsens) is not listed here. Its first intake is February 2028 ("Apply in 2027 for study start in February 2028"), so it has no autumn 2027 place.

Branding and Marketing Management and Fashion Design appear in VIA's list as AP degrees. They are the two specialisations of Design, Technology and Business, chosen when you apply, so they are recorded as that one programme.
The Animation Workshop pages redirect from en.via.dk to animationworkshop.via.dk, and its application steps only appear in a browser.
VIA teaches in Danish on its other campuses (Aarhus among them). Only the three campuses with an English-taught first degree are listed here.

programmes.name: Architectural Technology and Construction Management
programmes.summary: Planning, designing and managing construction projects, from the first sketch to the finished building, built around project work on real buildings of increasing size and a 20-week internship. A professional bachelor in Horsens. Maths at C level is the only subject requirement.
programmes.requirementsText: Admission requirements - One of the following: Upper secondary school leaving certificate/high school exam; The International or the European Baccalaureate; The Danish Admission course for Engineering programmes; [...] Specific admission requirements: A C-level in Mathematics = 125 instructional hours of 60 minutes each. [...] Each of the subjects above must be passed with a min. average of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.
extraRequirements: English at B level (minimum 2.0), or an accepted English test

programmes.name: Construction Technology
programmes.degree: AP degree – academy profession, not a bachelor's
programmes.summary: A two-year academy profession (AP) degree for construction technicians: planning building projects and handling their technical and administrative tasks, with digital tools and a focus on sustainable construction. It includes a 10-week internship. It is shorter than a bachelor's. Maths at C level is the only subject requirement.
programmes.requirementsText: The International or the European Baccalaureate with Mathematics equivalent to a Danish C-level [...] A Mathematics C-level is 125 instructional hours of 60 minutes each. [...] Each of the subjects above must be passed with a min. average of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.
extraRequirements: English at B level (minimum 2.0), or an accepted English test

programmes.name: Design, Technology and Business
programmes.degree: AP degree – academy profession, not a bachelor's
programmes.summary: A two-year academy profession (AP) degree for the fashion and lifestyle industry, taught in Herning. You choose Fashion Design or Branding and Marketing Management when you apply, do an admissions assignment, and take a 9-week internship. It is shorter than a bachelor's.
programmes.requirementsText: Mathematics equivalent to a Danish C-level (125 instructional hours of 60 minutes each). English equivalent to a Danish B-level (210 hours instructional hours of 60 minutes each) or a Danish C-level (75 hours instructional hours of 60 minutes each) AND a valid English test. All of the above subjects must be passed with a minimum average of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.
extraRequirements: English at B level, or English at C level plus a valid English test (minimum 2.0)
An admissions assignment for your chosen specialisation

programmes.name: Climate and Supply Engineering
programmes.summary: Applied engineering for the utilities and the green transition: drinking water, waste water, rainwater and climate adaptation, and green energy supply. It takes three and a half years, with a 20-week internship. Needs Maths A, Physics B, Chemistry C and English B.
programmes.requirementsText: Mathematics equivalent to a Danish A-level. Physics equivalent to a Danish B-level or Geoscience equivalent to a Danish A-level. Chemistry equivalent to a Danish C-level or Biotechnology equivalent to a Danish A-level. English equivalent to a Danish B-level. [...] Each of the subjects above must be passed with a min. average of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.
extraRequirements: Chemistry at C level or Biotechnology at A level (minimum 2.0)

programmes.name: Global Business Engineering
programmes.summary: Engineering combined with marketing, finance, management and communication, with a specialisation in either sustainable transition or mechanical technology. It is four and a half years, longer than VIA's other engineering degrees. Needs Maths B and English A rather than the usual Maths A.
programmes.requirementsText: Mathematics equivalent to a Danish B-level (applicants with Danish Admission course for engineering programmes are required to have Mathematics at an A-level). English equivalent to a Danish A-level. [...] Each of the subjects above must be passed with a min. average of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.summary: Applied mechanical engineering focused on product development, design, materials and sustainable construction, with a 20-week internship. Three and a half years in Horsens. Needs Maths A, Physics B, Chemistry C and English B.
programmes.requirementsText: Mathematics equivalent to a Danish A-level. English equivalent to a Danish B-level. Physics equivalent to a Danish B-level or Geoscience equivalent to a Danish A-level. Chemistry equivalent to a Danish C-level or Biotechnology equivalent to a Danish A-level. [...] Each of the subjects above must be passed with a min. average of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.
extraRequirements: Chemistry at C level or Biotechnology at A level (minimum 2.0)

programmes.name: Software Technology Engineering
programmes.summary: Software development from scratch: programming, web development, software design, algorithms, DevOps and machine learning, organised as semester projects and a 20-week internship. You can then specialise in interactive media, business information systems or machine learning and AI. Needs Maths A, Physics B and English B.
programmes.requirementsText: Mathematics equivalent to a Danish A-level. Physics equivalent to a Danish B-level or Geoscience equivalent to a Danish A-level. English equivalent to a Danish B-level. [...] Each of the subjects above must be passed with a min. average of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.

programmes.name: Software Technology Engineering – XR
programmes.summary: VIA's software engineering degree specialised in augmented, virtual and mixed reality, taught in Viborg alongside The Animation Workshop. It takes three and a half years, with a 20-week internship. Needs Maths A, Physics B and English B.
programmes.requirementsText: Mathematics equivalent to a Danish A-level. Physics equivalent to a Danish B-level or Geoscience equivalent to a Danish A-level. English equivalent to a Danish B-level. [...] Each of the subjects above must be passed with a min. average of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.

programmes.name: Character Animation
programmes.summary: Animating characters in 2D and 3D at The Animation Workshop in Viborg, with film-making projects alongside Computer Graphic Arts students and a 10-week studio internship. It lasts 3 years and 3 months, and admission is decided on talent: a portfolio, an admission test and an interview.
programmes.requirementsText: You can apply based on a foreign upper secondary school certificate (high school, baccalaureate, IB or similar). [...] All applicants (including native English speakers) must document English proficiency. It must be equivalent to a Danish B-level with a minimum weighted grade point average score of 2.0 on the Danish grading scale.
extraRequirements: English at B level (minimum 2.0), or an accepted English test
A portfolio, cover letter and video introduction, uploaded by 15 March
An online admission test and an interview, if invited
26 admitted from 368 applicants in 2025, according to The Animation Workshop.

It lasts 3 years and 3 months, with admission on a portfolio, an admission test and an interview.

It lasts 3 years and 9 months and admits only in odd-numbered years, so 2027 is an intake year. Admission is on a portfolio, a drawing test, an essay and an interview.
